description: This file defines the 'PayGradeModel' class within the OrangeHRM system, serving as a data model for representing pay grades with associated currencies for API serialization. It includes methods to convert the model to an array structure used for API responses, and uses annotations for OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: PayGradeModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing PayGrade entities along with their associated currencies for API responses in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the PayGradeModel instance into an array suitable for JSON serialization, including the pay grade's id, name, and list of associated currencies with their ids and names.
